artifact_evidence.diagnosis: The -17pp is driven by COMPOSITION/COVERAGE bias in which contracts have an observed n_bidders in the degraded extract (biased low-SB pre-2018, corrupted-inflated 2018). The not-yet-treated design on this broken field manufactures the -17pp. Rebuilding from authoritative raw-TED OFFERS_RECEIVED_NUMBER removes the bias and the effect reverses to +9.4pp (canonical C&S).
